# dsh-opencode-gateway
**English** | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that wires the local opencode ecosystem into DSH's model menu with t
(DSH) plugin that wires the local opencode ecosystem into DSH's model menu with two provider routes:
| Route | Endpoint | What it carries |
| `opencode-gateway` | `http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1` (the local opencode-api-plugin gateway) | Everythi
ng the gateway aggregates: the OpenCode Go subscription (reading the machine's local opencode login

state), OpenCode Zen, and any custom upstreams in `gateway.config.json` |
| `opencode-free` | in-pro
cess loopback proxy (default `http://127.0.0.1:10102/v1`) | The Zen free tier via the companion gate
way's **`oc2api` service** (default `http://127.0.0.1:18090`, `lanes.oc2api.port` in `gateway.config
.json`) — uTLS client fingerprinting, egress rotation; `mode: "embedded"` falls back to the inlined
opencode2api port driving the machine's own `opencode serve` |
By design this plugin ships **no usage panel**; quota display lives in the gateway's `/api/usage` an
his plugin ships **no usage panel**; quota display lives in the gateway's `/api/usage` and the tray.
## Features
- **Curated OpenCode Go registry** — the default menu follows the user's ZCode list (15 models); dis
play names, context windows, effort vocabularies, vision flags and a refusal list for 41 entries, me
asured request-by-request and ported from AIMFllyYS/dsh-protocom-api (MIT) — including the measured
quirks (Go spells its disable word `off` and refuses `none`; grok/muse serve `/responses` only, whic

h the gateway converts transparently).
- **Live model discovery** (soft-failing) — both routes mount
immediately with configured/seed menus and upgrade in place once the endpoint's listing answers; a

failed read keeps the current facts serving.
- **Service lifecycle** — in `service` mode (default) t
he free route talks to the oc2api service the companion gateway already owns: the gateway's `lanes.o
c2api` block starts and stops it, so the plugin spawns nothing and only needs the endpoint + key. `e

mbedded` mode manages `opencode serve` itself.
- **In-process loopback bridge** — pi-ai's transport
needs a real URL, so the plugin exposes the free backend's OpenAI surface on an HTTP listener bound
to loopback only (default 10102, configurable); in `service` mode it is an authenticated passthrough
to the Go service, in `embedded` mode it wraps the LocalProxy functions. The listener never holds t
he host's event loop, so headless tasks still exit.
## System requirements

- **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2 and < 0.3.0-0** (measured peer range); verified on **0.2.0-rc.2**
- The free ti
er (default `service` mode) needs the companion gateway running with its `lanes.oc2api` block enable
d — that block owns `bin\oc2api.exe` and the port the plugin talks to (default `18090`). The plugin
does not start it: set `free.serviceUrl` to whatever `lanes.oc2api.port` is, and `OPENCODE2API_SERVE

R_KEY` to the same value as `lanes.oc2api.apiKey`.
- The free tier in `embedded` mode needs the open
code CLI installed; `opencode auth login` is recommended (better model list and limits, anonymous wo

rks too)
- The gateway route needs the companion gateway EDDY597/opencode-api-plugin running (`start

-gateway.cmd`, `start-tray-hidden.vbs` or the tray)
- The gateway route also requires the gateway's
`opencode-go` upstream to be **enabled with `prefix: "go"`** (the gateway's example config does this
) and `OPENCODE_GATEWAY_KEY=<gateway token>` in `~/.dsh/.env`. Missing either one makes the Go card'
s refresh report "missing credential / HTTP 401 / empty listing" explicitly instead of failing silen
fresh report "missing credential / HTTP 401 / empty listing" explicitly instead of failing silently.

## Configure
The plugin installs no settings UI; configuration lives in the composition layer (the profile's `cor
dis.patch.yml`, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/` on the desktop app) and takes effect on restart:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Upgrading from the 18080 setup
Until recently the free route defaulted to `http://127.0.0.1:18080` with `manageService: true`. Both
are wrong for tool calling, and the spawn target no longer exists:
| Symptom | Cause |
| Free models answer text but **never call tools** | 18080 is the gateway's `src/cli-server.ts` shim
— a buffered adapter that waits for the whole reply, rebuilds it as text and keeps only text parts,
so every `tool_calls` is dropped. `oc2api` (:18090) forwards tools and streaming verbatim. Measured
2026-10-30 with one identical request: gateway `free/big-pickle` → `tool_calls`, `:18090` directly

→ `tool_calls`, `:18080` → none. |
[该节后续省略]
## Model manager page
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
- **Two routes, one adapter**: `PiAiAdapter` reads the current profiles snapshot once per operation;
changed discovery facts atomically `replace` the registration — no restart, no disturbed in-flight

stream.
- **Loopback bridge**: request bodies buffer into a fetch `Request`; responses stream back o
ut. A mid-stream drop after the headers are flushed destroys the socket instead of throwing `ERR_HTT

P_HEADERS_SENT` into the server callback.
- **Single retry layer**: the plugin's `retryPolicy` defau
lts to `normal/maxRetries 0` — retries belong to the gateway (subscription routes) or the inlined pr

oxy (free route), never both.
- **Thinking bridging**: `reasoning_content`, `reasoning` + `reasoning
_details`, and inline think tags all flow through pi-ai's delta parser into DSH's reasoning-delta co
llapse (the gateway strips Go routes' inline tags server-side).
